autoAcceptSettings.title: Auto-Accept Settings
autoAcceptSettings.intro: Automatically import newly assigned GitHub issues into Tendril plans at regular intervals.

createIssue.title: Create GitHub Issue #{{planId}}
createIssue.description: CreateIssue writes the issue body from the plan and opens it with `gh` in the selected repository.
createIssue.descriptionForSubject: CreateIssue opens this with `gh` in the selected repository. The issue is filed against plan #{{planId}}, but describes the {{kind}} rather than the plan's own work.
createIssue.descriptionForSubject_recommendation: CreateIssue opens this with `gh` in the selected repository. The issue is filed against plan #{{planId}}, but describes the recommendation rather than the plan's own work.

issueTitle.label: Title
issueTitle.required: A title is required: the plan's own title is not used here.

body.label: Body
body.placeholder: What should be done, and why…
body.hint: Edit before filing if the wording is terse. The agent formats it into Markdown and keeps your words rather than rewriting them.

repository.label: Repository
repository.none: Neither the plan nor its project records a repository, so there is nowhere to run {{command}}. Add one to the plan first.
repository.hint: The local repository path the issue is opened against, not an owner/name slug.

labels.label: Labels
labels.hint: Comma-separated. Assignee and labels are free text: the service exposes issue metadata, not the org's assignable users, so there is no list to pick from.

comment.label: Comment
comment.placeholder: Extra context to append to the issue body…

createPr.title: Create PR for #{{planId}}
createPr.description: CreatePr pushes the plan's branch, opens the PR and — unless you say otherwise — merges it and deletes the branch.

merge.label: Merge
merge.hint: Unchecked opens the PR without merging.

deleteBranch.label: Delete Branch
deleteBranch.hint: Deletes the branch pushed to origin after successful merge.
deleteBranch.hint_multiple: Deletes the branches pushed to origin after successful merge.

draft.label: Create as Draft
draft.hint: A draft PR cannot be merged.

reviewers.label: Reviewers
reviewers.hint: Comma-separated GitHub logins. V2 has no separate assignee field — the CLI folds an assignee into the reviewer list, so these are the same channel.

comment.label: Comment
comment.placeholder: Anything the reviewer should know before reading the diff…

deleteProject.title: Delete Project
deleteProject.intro: This permanently deletes project <name>{{name}}</name> and everything it owns on disk. It cannot be undone.
deleteProject.plans: Every plan of this project, with its revisions and verification reports.
deleteProject.folder: {{root}}{{name}} — its cloned repositories, skills, MCP definitions and memories, including any commit that was never pushed.
deleteProject.database: Its plans, jobs and recommendations in Tendril's database.
deleteProject.logsKept: Job logs are kept: they are stored by job id rather than by project.
deleteProject.removeInstead: To remove the project from Tendril without touching anything on disk, cancel and use Remove Project instead.

dirtyRepo.title: Local Changes Detected
dirtyRepo.description_one: ⚠ {{count}} repository has uncommitted changes. They will not be included in the worktree the agent works in.
dirtyRepo.description_other: ⚠ {{count}} repositories have uncommitted changes. They will not be included in the worktree the agent works in.

jobDebug.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard

noProjects.title: No Projects
noProjects.description: Every plan belongs to a project, and this Tendril home has none yet.
noProjects.body: Add a project under <location>Settings → Projects</location> — a name, its repositories and the verifications its plans run — then create the plan again.

description.items_one: ⚠ This plan has {{count}} item that no UpdatePlan run has incorporated yet.
description.items_other: ⚠ This plan has {{count}} items that no UpdatePlan run has incorporated yet.
description.annotations_one: ⚠ This plan has {{count}} annotation that haven't been incorporated yet. Executing now would ignore them.
description.annotations_other: ⚠ This plan has {{count}} annotations that haven't been incorporated yet. Executing now would ignore them.
description.answers_one: ⚠ This plan has {{count}} answered question that haven't been incorporated yet. Executing now means the agent reads them as they stand rather than as part of the plan.
description.answers_other: ⚠ This plan has {{count}} answered questions that haven't been incorporated yet. Executing now means the agent reads them as they stand rather than as part of the plan.
description.both: ⚠ This plan has {{annotations}} and {{answers}} that haven't been incorporated yet. Executing now would ignore the annotations, and the agent would read the answers as they stand rather than as part of the plan.

pendingAnnotations.body: Executing now runs the plan as written, so those notes will not shape what the agent does. Running UpdatePlan first folds them into the plan body.

resetToDraft.title: Reset Plan #{{planId}} to Draft
resetToDraft.body: The plan returns to <state>Draft</state> and its worktrees are removed, discarding any uncommitted work inside them. Commits already pushed are not affected.

partialDelivery.title: Verification Failed
partialDelivery.body: Plan #{{planId}} is recorded as <state>Completed</state> and flagged as a partial delivery, despite these failing verifications:

deletePlan.title: Delete Plan
deletePlan.body: Are you sure you want to permanently delete plan #{{planId}}? This removes the plan folder, all revisions and all verification reports, and cannot be undone. To keep the folder, move the plan to Skipped or Icebox instead.

removeProject.title: Remove Project
removeProject.question: Are you sure you want to remove project <name>{{name}}</name>?
removeProject.consequence: This removes the project from config.yaml. Its cloned repositories, plan folders and history stay on disk, so nothing is deleted from your machine - but Tendril will stop listing the project, and its existing plans and jobs will name a project it no longer knows.

shareTunnel.title: Share Work
shareTunnel.intro: Share your work with teammates via a secure, read-only Cloudflare tunnel. Reviewers can inspect plans, diffs, and leave comments without having access to your terminal or settings.

connecting.title: Tunnel Starting
connecting.body: Starting share tunnel... This typically takes 15-30 seconds.

active.title: Share Active
active.body: Your share tunnel is active with read-only & comment-only permissions.

notAllowed.title: Plan #{{planId}} is not taking changes
notAllowed.state: The plan is {{state}}. A change request lands only while it is in Review, or while it is already applying one.
notAllowed.commentsKept_one: The {{count}} comment(s) are still here — send them once the plan is back in Review.
notAllowed.commentsKept_other: The {{count}} comment(s) are still here — send them once the plan is back in Review.

fromApp.title: Update Plan #{{planId}}
fromApp.summary_one: {{count}} comment(s) from the running app will be sent to the agent as a change request.
fromApp.summary_other: {{count}} comment(s) from the running app will be sent to the agent as a change request.
fromApp.queueNote_one: Plan #{{planId}} already has {{count}} job(s) in flight, so this one queues behind them and starts when they finish.
fromApp.queueNote_other: Plan #{{planId}} already has {{count}} job(s) in flight, so this one queues behind them and starts when they finish.

diff.title: Request Changes for Plan #{{planId}}
diff.description: Provide suggestions or instructions for changes to the implementation. RetryPlan resumes in the existing worktree and applies them as a delta on the work already committed.
diff.inlineNote_one: {{count}} inline comment(s) on file diffs will be included with your feedback.
diff.inlineNote_other: {{count}} inline comment(s) on file diffs will be included with your feedback.
diff.requestPlaceholder: Describe what needs to be changed, fixed or rewritten in the worktree…

unansweredQuestions.title: Unanswered Questions
unansweredQuestions.description_one: ⚠ This plan has {{count}} unanswered question. Executing now leaves it to the agent, which will take the recommended option where there is one and decide for itself where there is not.
unansweredQuestions.description_other: ⚠ This plan has {{count}} unanswered questions. Executing now leaves them to the agent, which will take the recommended option where there is one and decide for itself where there is not.

updatePlan.title: Update Plan #{{planId}}
updatePlan.description: Provide instructions for revising this plan. UpdatePlan rewrites the plan into a new revision — it does not touch any code.
updatePlan.alreadyRunning: UpdatePlan is already running for this plan. Please wait…
